invariants: Spare Request internal/tracking identity survives official SR7 assignment/correction
all current/requested Customer context derives through exactly one Service Request and selected Needs remain same-SR
accepted submission freezes immutable allocation/logistics/recipient evidence and MSG generation alone is never submission
a false-submission correction preserves the old snapshot and may restore current Draft semantics without deleting history
SR7 and C10 values are globally non-reusable aliases while internal identities remain stable
one RMA represents one promised item/obligation and authorization may make partial deterministic progress
RMA assignment is planning evidence only and never proves receipt, installation or return selection
implementation_rule: Both leaves are one normative request/RMA schema family; all original indexes and append-only/non-reuse obligations remain mandatory.
